patch.value: SDK unified author-time preflight capstone: preflightExtension + assertExtensionPreflight

Unify the SDK three separate author-time checks (lintExtensionBlueprint, synthesizeExtensionManifest, checkExtensionManifestCompatibility) into one pure preflightExtension(blueprint, options) capstone returning a consolidated ExtensionPreflightReport, plus a throwing assertExtensionPreflight CI/test bookend. Author-time analog of createExtensionTestHarness (pm-jcyn) which unified the runtime-test helpers: one call validates a declarative package before publishing instead of chaining 4-5 asserts. SDK-only, consistent with lint/synthesize/compat (none have CLI surface).

value.text: PR #351 bot-review round (2026-06-23): Gemini flagged a real broader bug beyond the initial manifest_capabilities_absent curation — ANY capability-drift finding the blueprint lint derives from a stale in-module manifest mirror (notably the BLOCKING capability_undeclared) is a false positive once an identity synthesizes a fresh authoritative manifest, and falsely flipped report.ok=false. Fixed by curating all CAPABILITY_DRIFT_LINT_CODES from the consolidated view, suppressed only when synthesizing without an explicit declaredCapabilities (explicit set always honored); raw report.blueprint keeps every finding. CodeRabbit: accepted SDK.md pm-ozaf tracker ref; declined cross-module {@link ../sdk/compose.js#preflightExtension} nitpick (file-qualified links are the codebase convention for cross-module refs, matching assertExtensionManifestCompatible). Codex not connected; Sourcery weekly-capped.
